answer: Admit newcomers only in small monthly cohorts that share the risk. Each of twenty newcomers locks a 1,900 POA cohort bond, and a mirror of every member's work sits in one open ledger, each verified job marked with a single pearl. If any member is proven fake within 90 days, every member loses 10% of its bond, so one fake costs its nineteen neighbours 190 POA each. A farm hiding fifty fakes must stake 95,000 POA and keeps paying for every neighbour it betrays, while a record in plain umber ink leaves no copy hidden.
